findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: save_recipe, set_recipe_image, import_from_url, manage_family · Private data: save_recipe, start_recipe_draft, share_with_family · Public sink: manage_family, manage_menu, shopping_list, share_with_family · Destructive: delete_recipe, manage_categories, manage_menu, shopping_list.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: save_recipe, set_recipe_image, import_from_url, manage_family · Private data: save_recipe, start_recipe_draft, share_with_family · Public sink: manage_family, manage_menu, shopping_list, share_with_family · Destructive: delete_recipe, manage_categories, manage_menu, shopping_list

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
